crossRefs.note: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are…
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…
Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will…
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

translations.web: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
translations.bsb: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
translations.kjv: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
translations.asv: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:
